verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai foi le ALII ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring me an offering: of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering.
verses.sm: Ia e fai atu i le fanauga a Isaraelu, ia latou au mai le taulaga ia te au, e taitasi le tagata ma le mea ua manatu fua i ai i lona loto, tou te talia mai ai le taulaga ia te au.

verses.en: And this is the offering which ye shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.sm: O le taulaga foi lenei tou te talia mai ia i latou, o le auro, ma le ario, atoa ma le ‘apa memea;

verses.en: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats' hair,
verses.sm: ma ie uli, ma le pauli, ma le mumu, ma le ie vavae, ma fulufulu ‘oti,

verses.en: And rams' skins dyed red, and badgers' skins, and shittim wood,
verses.sm: ma pau mamoe poa ua faalanu wawa, ma pa‘u takesa, ma le laau o le setima;

verses.en: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,
verses.sm: o le suauu e mu a“ le a6, o mea manogi e ‘manogi a“ le uu e uu au, e fai aʻi foi le mea manogi lelei e mu;

verses.en: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
verses.sm: O maa soama, ma maa e teu ai i le efota, atoa ma le ufifatafata.

verses.en: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
verses.sm: Ia latou faia foi mo aʻu se malumalu, ou te nofo ai faatasi ma i latou;

verses.en: According to all that I shew thee, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall ye make it.
verses.sm: e tusa ma mea uma lava ou te faaali ai ia te oe, pei o le faatusa o le malumalu, ma le faatusa o ana mea uma lava; ia faapea ona outou faia.

verses.en: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.sm: Ia latou fai foi le atolaau i le laau o le setima; e lua kupita ma le vaeluagalemu o le kupita lona umi, o le kupita ma le vaeluagalemu o le kupita lona lau, o le kupita foi ma le vaeluagalemu o le kupita lona maualuga.

verses.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, within and without shalt thou overlay it, and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about.
verses.sm: la e ufiufi foi i ai i le auro lelei, i totonu ma tua c te ufiufi ai; ia e fai foi i ona luga o le pale auro e siosioina ai.

verses.en: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.
verses.sm: la e tunu le auro i le fai ai o mama e fa, ta ia e tuuina i ona tuli ato e fa, e lua mama i le tasi ona itu, e lua foi mama i le tasi ona itu.

verses.en: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.sm: la e fai foi amo o le laau o le setima, ma ia e ufiufi ai i le auro;

verses.en: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.
verses.sm: ona e sulu atu lea o amo i totonu o mama i ona itu o le atolaau, e amo a“ le atolaau.

verses.en: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
verses.sm: Ia tuu pea lava amo i mama o le atolaau, aua le aveeseina ai.

verses.en: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee.
verses.sm: Ia e tuu foi i totonu o le atolaau le tulafono ou te avatu ai ia te oe.

verses.en: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.sm: la e fai foi le nofoa o le alofa i le auro lelei; e lua kupita ma le vaeluagalemu o le kupita lona umi, o le kupita foi e tasi ma le vaeluagalemu o le kupita lona lau.

verses.en: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shalt thou make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.
verses.sm: Ia e fai foi kerupi auro e lua ia e togitogi faamamanuina i pito e lua o le nofoa o le alofa.

verses.en: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
verses.sm: Ia e fai le tasi kerupi i le tasi pito nofoa, o le tasi foi kerupi i le tasi pito nofoa; o le mea e fai a'i le nofoa o le alofa tou te fai ai foi kerupi i ona pito nofoa e lua.

verses.en: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.
verses.sm: E falò foi e kerupi o la apaau i luga, ia faamalumalu ifo le nofoa o le alofa ¡o la apaau; e fesagai foi o la mata; ia faasaga foi o mata o kerupi i le nofoa o le alofa.

verses.en: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
verses.sm: la e faaee foi le nofoa o le alofa i luga o le atolaau; e te tuu foi i le atolaau o le tulafono ou te avatu al ia te oe.

verses.en: And there I will meet with thee, and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel.
verses.sm: Ta te fetaiai ma a'u i lea mea, ma ou tautala atu 1a te oe ai luga o le nofoa o le alofa, ai le va o kerupi e lua i luga o le atolaau o le tulafono, i mea uma lava ou te fai atu ai ia te oe, e te fai atu i le fanauga a Isaraelu.

verses.en: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.sm: Ia e fai foi le laoai i le laau o le setima; e lua kupita lona umi, o le kupita e tasi lona lau, o le kupita ma le vaeluagalemu o le kupita lona maualuga.

verses.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
verses.sm: E te ufiufi ai foi i le auro lelei, ma fai ai le pale auro e siosioina ai.

verses.en: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
verses.sm: E te fai ai foi o lona tafatafa i lalo e siosioina ai, o le lautele o le alofilima e tasi lona lau; ma ia e fai le pale auro mo le tafatafa i lalo e siosioina ai.

verses.en: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.
verses.sm: la e fai ai foi mama auro e fa, ma tuu taitasi mama i ona tuli laoai e fa, i ona vae e fa;

verses.en: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.
verses.sm: ia. felatai mama ma le tafatafa i lalo, e fai ma mea e tuu ai amo, e amo a‘i le laoai.

verses.en: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
verses.sm: E te fai ona amo ile laau o le setima, ma ufiufi ai i le auro, e amo a“ le laoai.

verses.en: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shalt thou make them.
verses.sm: E te fai foi ona tanoa salalafa, ma ona ipu, o ona tanoa, ma ona ipu e asu a“, e liligi i ai; c te faia ia mea i le auro lelei.

verses.en: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.
verses.sm: E te laulauina foi i luga o le laoai o le areto e laulauina i luma, ia le aunoa i o‘u luma.

verses.en: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.
verses.sm: E te fai foi le tuugalamepa i le auro lelei, e te fai ai le tuugalamepa e togitogi faamamanuina; e faia i lea lava mea o lona ‘au, ma ona maga, ma ona ipu faaofuofu, o ona pona, ma ona fuga.

verses.en: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:
verses.sm: E o atu maga e ono i ona itu, e tolu maga o le tuugalamepa i le tasi itu, c tolu foi maga o le tuugalamepa i le tasi itu.

verses.en: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.
verses.sm: E tolu ipu faaofuofu e pei o sekati, o le pona foi atoa ma le fuga i le maga e tasi; e tolu foi ipu faaofuofu e pei o sekati i le tasi maga, o le pona ma le fuga; ia faapea i maga e ono e o atu nai le tuugalamepa.

verses.en: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.
verses.sm: E i le tuugalamepa foi o ipu faaofuofu e fa e pei o sekati, o ona pona atoa ma ona fuga;

verses.en: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.
verses.sm: o le pona i lalo o isi ona maga e lua, ma le pona i lalo o isi ona maga e lua, ma le pona i lalo o isi ona maga e lua; e faatatau i maga e ono e o atu nai le tuugálamepa.

verses.en: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.sm: O lea lava mea e fai ak ona pona ma ona maga; e faia atoa uma i le auro lelei e tasi e togitogi faamamanuina.

verses.en: And thou shalt make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.
verses.sm: E te fai ai foi ona lamepa e fitu, na tc faaee i luga foi ona lamepa e faamalamalama a“ i ona lava luma.

verses.en: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.
verses.sm: E fai foi ona selelamepa ma ona tuugamatapa‘u o le afi i le auro lelei;

verses.en: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.
verses.sm: e fai ai i le taleni o le auro lelei, atoa ma ia mea uma lava.

verses.en: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.
verses.sm: Ia oe lava, ia e faia e pei o le faatusa sa faaali atu ia ic oe i le mauga.
